---
title: "Untether 0.36.0 — live Claude sessions, steerable follow-ups and safer unattended runs"
---

## TL;DR
Claude Code sessions now stay live after an answer. Background agents report back in the chat, and you can steer a run while it's working. Unattended crons and webhooks no longer wait on a button nobody can tap, and Codex safe mode is now properly read-only. This release has six breaking changes, so please read **Heads up** before you upgrade.

## ✨ What's new for you
- **Live Claude sessions.** When Claude keeps working after its reply (background agents, monitors, scheduled wake-ups), those turns now arrive as their own messages, with working approval buttons. Follow-ups go straight into the running session instead of waiting for it to exit ([#776](https://github.com/littlebearapps/untether/issues/776)).
- **Background task panel.** The progress message lists background agents with elapsed time, tokens and current step. After the answer, a single status message keeps you up to date.
- **Steer or queue follow-ups.** Choose per chat or topic whether a message sent mid-run waits for the turn to end (`queue`) or folds into the running turn (`steer`) ([#775](https://github.com/littlebearapps/untether/issues/775)). Use `/steer` or `/queue` for a one-off, or set the default on the new `/config` Follow-up page.
- **Context use at a glance.** Claude's status line now ends with how full the context window is, e.g. `62% ctx`, and compaction shows as a `🗜️ Context compacted` row instead of looking like a stall. API retries and safeguard stops get their own rows too.
- **Stop at limit actually stops.** With **Stop at limit** on, reaching your daily budget pauses new runs until midnight, with a one-off **Run anyway** button. Today's spend now survives restarts.
- **Replies carry context.** Reply to a message (or a selected quote) and the agent sees the text you replied to. Thanks to [@Dvredin](https://github.com/Dvredin) for this one.
- **Per-cron model and effort.** A cron can set its own `model` and `reasoning`. Claude Code's own `auto` permission mode is now available alongside Untether's `plan-auto`.
- **Better exports.** `/export` sends the full transcript as a `.md` or `.json` file, covering every turn of a live session.
- **For shared chats.** The opt-in `approval_originator_only` setting lets only the person who started a run answer its approvals and questions.
- **A new home.** Untether now has its own website at [untether.cc](https://untether.cc). The help centre stays at [littlebearapps.com/help/untether](https://littlebearapps.com/help/untether/).

## 🛠️ Fixes you'll notice
- Approval buttons only work in the chat they were posted in, and a second tap says "Already answered".
- `/cancel` and `/new` in a forum topic only affect that topic, and `/cancel` stops a loop for good.
- The "waiting for you" reminder says what it's waiting for and disappears once you answer.
- Tidier Telegram formatting: tables, numbered lists and one-item-per-line replies keep their shape, and `CLAUDE.md` no longer becomes a link.
- Voice notes no longer hear "Clawde" or "Clawed Code".
- Codex, OpenCode and Pi keep your saved session when a resumed run fails for an unrelated reason, and Codex and OpenCode chats get proper `/usage` totals.
- OpenCode 2.x is refused with a clear message (Untether supports the 1.x CLI).
- Plus well over 100 smaller fixes to progress messages, background tasks, costs, triggers and file transfer.

## 🧹 Under the hood
- Security hardening: file-transfer deny globs match at any depth and through symlinks, `/browse` needs a project-bound chat, and logs mask credentials in URLs.
- Config is parsed once per edit rather than on every read, and hot-reload no longer misses quick edits.
- Dependency floors are raised past recent `anyio` and `aiohttp` advisories.
- Release testing now focuses on the four supported engines: Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode and Pi.

## ⚠️ Heads up
- **Gemini CLI and AMP are deprecated.** Both still ship and load, and no removal is scheduled. They're just no longer supported: Google ended Gemini CLI for individual accounts, and AMP refuses headless use. `/config` marks them with ⚠️. Antigravity CLI support is planned for 0.36.1.
- **`auto` is now `plan-auto`.** Untether's old `auto` (plan, then auto-approve) is renamed `plan-auto`, and `auto` now means Claude Code's own auto mode. Chat settings migrate automatically; if you set `permission_mode = "auto"` in `untether.toml` and want the old behaviour, change it to `plan-auto`.
- **Prompting modes now prompt.** `default`, `manual` and `acceptEdits` (what `/planmode off` sets) now ask before shell commands, web fetches and MCP tools.
- **Unattended runs deny approvals.** Cron and webhook runs no longer wait on buttons; approvals and questions are denied and the run carries on or reports back. Give every Claude cron that should act on its own an explicit `permission_mode` such as `plan-auto`, `auto` or `dontAsk`. The startup message lists affected crons.
- **Codex safe mode is read-only.** Edits, builds and tests fail in Safe. Switch chats or crons that need to change files to full auto.
- **Bypass flags in `extra_args` are refused.** Flags such as `--dangerously-skip-permissions` or `--yolo` stop that engine loading. Remove them; the security guide has the full list.
- **With Loop mode off, Claude can't schedule its own recurring tasks.** It's pointed to Loop mode or `/at` instead. `[loop] own_schedule = false` restores the old behaviour.

## ⬆️ Upgrade
Read [Upgrading to v0.36.0](https://littlebearapps.com/help/untether/update/#upgrading-to-v0360) first; it also lists the config keys to remove if you ever roll back to 0.35.4. Then upgrade with the tool you installed with:

```sh
uv tool upgrade untether
# or
pipx upgrade untether
```

Restart Untether (`systemctl --user restart untether`, or send `/restart` from Telegram) and run `untether doctor` for a quick preflight check.
